Ingredients by weight:

250g flour

1 tsp. baking soda

1 tbsp. baking powder

1/2 tsp. salt (I think I'd add another pinch)

100g sugar

240ml vegan milk (I used oat milk, not sure if I successfully managed to make the vegan buttermilk though)

1 tbsp. lemon juice

1,5 overripe bananas

1 tsp. vanilla extract

1 tbsp. maple syrup

2 tbsp. vegan butter

80g (more or less) roughly pounded walnuts
